text: ユウと　いっしょなら　かっても　まけても　しあわせ　だなんて　ふしぎだな

structure.jp: ユウと　いっしょなら
かっても　まけても
しあわせ　だなんて

patterns.name: 〜ても〜ても
patterns.span: かっても　まけても
patterns.explanation: Two て-forms each followed by も mean 'whether this or that, it makes no difference'. かっても　まけても = 'whether we win or lose'.

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.span: しあわせ　だなんて
patterns.explanation: なんて holds up what was just said as something surprising to comment on. しあわせ　だなんて = 'the idea that I'm happy'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if it is the case that'. いっしょなら = 'if we're together'.
